transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because… I’ve been making myself throw up after I eat. Not just once or twice—like it’s become this thing I keep doing, and I don’t feel like I can stop it the way I thought I could.

Sometimes it happens at work, like I’ll go into the bathroom there after eating, or if I manage to wait then it’s right when I get home. And I know that sounds awful to say out loud, but it’s started feeling like the only way I can calm myself down after I eat. Like everything in me gets so worked up and I hate the feeling, and then once I throw up there’s this… relief, I guess, even though I feel ashamed right after.

I just don’t want it to keep being like this.

Can you describe what typically happens before you feel the need to make yourself throw up? Are you eating large amounts of food in a short period of time, more than most people would eat under similar circumstances?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, it doesn’t always start with me thinking, “I’m going to eat a huge amount,” but once it starts, it’s like I just keep grabbing things. Like I’ll have a full bag of chips, then pastries I bought from the corner store, then whatever leftovers are in the fridge, and something sweet to drink too. And it’s all in one sitting, not spread out over the day.

Sometimes I don’t even really realize how much is gone until I look around and see the wrappers or containers, and then I feel this panic hit me. It’s embarrassing to say, because if someone else was sitting there, I don’t think they’d eat that much all at once. It feels like way more than a normal meal or snack.
How often do you feel the need to make yourself throw up after eating like this—like, how many times a week does it happen, if you can estimate?

It’s… it’s been going on for months now, not just like a bad week or something. Most weeks, it happens at least a couple times where I eat way more than I meant to, and then I get that panic feeling and I try to undo it somehow.

A lot of the time that means making myself throw up, but sometimes if I can’t or if I tell myself I won’t, then I’ll try to not eat for a long time after, or I’ll push myself to exercise it off. But if you’re asking about the throwing up specifically, I’d say it’s usually at least a few times a week. Some weeks are worse than others, but it’s not rare anymore. It’s become this pattern, and I hate admitting that.
Can you tell me if these episodes of eating a lot and then trying to undo it happen at least once a week on average over the past few months?

Yes… yes, it definitely has been at least once a week. Honestly, most weeks it’s more than that. For the past few months, there are usually at least a couple of times where I eat way more than I planned to, and then afterward I get scared and feel like I have to fix it somehow.

A lot of the time I make myself throw up, but if I don’t do that, I might try to go a long time without eating after, or I’ll push myself to exercise because I’m trying to undo what happened. It’s not just occasional anymore. It’s been happening week after week.
